title: Evaluation of a decision tree
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\alpha$ be a type, and let $A\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be the available coordinates. Evaluating a decision tree with available coordinates $A$ at an input $x\in(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n$ returns the leaf label if the tree is a leaf; at a query of coordinate $i$, it evaluates the zero-child tree when $x_i=0$ and the one-child tree otherwise.
